description: This is a shell script for device-initiated firmware download, handling upgrade checks, JSON communication with cloud servers, and firmware flashing procedures.

methods.name: updateFWDownloadStatus
methods.description: Updates firmware download status in a log file with protocol, status, reboot flag, failure reason, version, filename, last run time, and firmware update state.

methods.name: getFWVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current firmware version from version.txt based on version tags.

methods.name: getBuildType
methods.description: Determines whether the build is VBN, PROD, QA, or dev based on firmware version string.

methods.name: sendTLSRequest
methods.description: Performs a curl request to the cloud URL with TLS, checks for HTTP 200 response.

methods.name: tftpDownload
methods.description: Downloads firmware image via TFTP protocol.

methods.name: imageDownloadToLocalServer
methods.description: Triggers image download to local server, updates status, and logs progress.

methods.name: invokeImageFlasher
methods.description: Invokes external script to flash the firmware image.

methods.name: getServURL
methods.description: Determines server URL based on build type and configuration.

methods.name: triggerPCIUpgrade
methods.description: Initiates PCI firmware upgrade process, including download and flashing.

methods.name: checkForValidPCIUpgrade
methods.description: Checks if firmware versions differ and triggers upgrade if needed.

methods.name: checkForUpgrades
methods.description: Main upgrade logic, checks and triggers firmware upgrades.

methods.name: processJsonResponse
methods.description: Parses JSON response from server to extract firmware info and update internal variables.

methods.name: exitForXconf404response
methods.description: Handles HTTP 404 response from server, logs, and exits process.

methods.name: createJsonString
methods.description: Creates JSON string with device info for server communication.

methods.name: sendXCONFTLSRequest
methods.description: Sends TLS request to XCONF server with retry logic.

methods.name: sendXCONFRequest
methods.description: Sends XCONF request and handles response.

methods.name: sendJsonRequestToCloud
methods.description: Sends JSON request to cloud server, processes response, and manages retries.
